subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Safety equipment: where, when and why it is used (sunglasses, hard hat, armbands); traffic lights

show.line: Red means stop. Orange means wait. Green means go. Look both ways!

rounds.prompt: You swim in the pool. What keeps you safe?
The sun is very bright. What do you wear?
Before you cross the road, you look left and...?

rounds.praise: Builders wear hard hats to keep safe.

hints: Red at the top means stop.
Safety gear protects one part of the body.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! The light is red.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Red means stop.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Red means stop. Green means go!

parent_line: Knows traffic light colours and when to use safety gear.
